description: This file defines the PEAR_Command_Mirror class, which implements the 'download-all' command for the PEAR package management system. It includes methods for executing the command, handling dependencies, and interacting with remote package repositories.

classes.name: PEAR_Command_Mirror
classes.description: Class implementing the 'download-all' command for PEAR, providing functionality to retrieve and download package lists from remote repositories.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for PEAR_Command_Mirror, initializes with UI and config objects.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Creates and returns a PEAR_Command object for testing purposes.

methods.name: doDownloadAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available packages from the master server and downloads them, handling errors and remote interactions.
